title: Analytic integration of metric-valued functions in Lipschitz free spaces
summary: We develop an integration theory for functions taking values in a metric space. Following a Bochner-type construction, we define the concept of free integral as an element of the Lipschitz-free space $\mathcal{F}(M)$. We establish the main properties of this integral, including duality formulas, and the study of the resulting space of free integrable functions. We also cover when the metric space is a Banach space: in this setting, the free integral has an interpretable decomposition generalising the Bochner integral.
